# SiteOwned

> SiteOwned builds or moves a small-business website mostly with AI, for a one-time fee. The owner keeps the files and the free hosting. There is no Squarespace or Wix subscription. The required cost after launch is the domain, about $12 a year. Optional edit plans are separate and are not required to keep the site online. Contact: hello@siteowned.ai

SiteOwned is a done-for-you AI website builder. Most of the drafting is AI. A person reviews the draft before launch. It does not publish testimonials, reviews, ratings, or client statistics.

The live site is https://aristowong.github.io/SiteOwned/

## Pages

- [Home](https://aristowong.github.io/SiteOwned/): One-time fee website, built by AI, owned by the business. No monthly builder fee.
- [Small business websites](https://aristowong.github.io/SiteOwned/small-business/): Cheap website for a small business, including a move off Squarespace or Wix.
- [ClinicSite](https://aristowong.github.io/SiteOwned/clinics/): Physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech, and chiropractic websites. No patient data is stored on the site.
- [DIY website course](https://aristowong.github.io/SiteOwned/course/): Own Your Site, for people who want to do the work themselves.

The page at /clinics/sample/ is a fictional layout example. It is marked noindex and is not a client.

## Small business prices

- AI Move: $249 one-time. Copies an existing Squarespace or Wix site onto free hosting the owner controls.
- AI Launch: $399 one-time. New site, 1 to 5 pages, from a 10-question intake, with AI-written copy, a human review, Google Business Profile setup, and the domain connected.
- AI Edits: $9 per month, optional. Unlimited small edits by text or email. Canceling does not take the site down.

## ClinicSite prices

ClinicSite is SiteOwned for physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech, and chiropractic practices.

- AI Move: $399 one-time. Moves the current site, connects a booking or EMR link such as Jane, WebPT, or SimplePractice, and connects the Google profile.
- AI Launch: $699 one-time. New site, up to 8 pages: condition and service pages, provider bios, insurance information, and local wording such as “pediatric OT in Redondo Beach.”
- AI Edits: $19 per month, optional. Unlimited small edits by text or email.

No patient data is stored on the site. Intake goes through the practice’s own HIPAA-compliant tools. The website only links to them.

## DIY course prices

Own Your Site: The SiteOwned DIY Course.

- Course: $49. The lessons, including the clinic bonus.
- Course + Templates: $89. The course plus starter templates for a small business and a clinic.
- Course + 45-minute done-with-you call: $199. The course plus one working call. Templates are not included unless that is agreed before payment.

## How the work is done

1. Intake, or the URL of the site to move.
2. AI drafts the pages and the words.
3. A person reviews the draft.
4. Launch on free hosting the owner controls.
5. Later edits by text or email, with AI, if the owner wants that help.

There is no checkout on the site. The contact form opens an email to hello@siteowned.ai.
